itens.titulo: U.S. Treasury yields rise as traders wrap up volatile week
itens.descricao: U.S. Treasury yields rise as traders wrap up volatile week CNBC
trechos: The benchmark 10-year Treasury yield added more than 3 basis points to 5.123%, and the 30-year Treasury bond yield advanced more than 2 basis points to 5.457%.
The 2-year Treasury note yield was up more than 1 basis point at 4.763%.
One basis point is equal to 0.01%, and yields and prices move in opposite directions.

It's been a week of strong inflation data, with Thursday's producer price index showing that wholesale prices jumped 6.3% annually in September, the biggest gain since 2022, according to the Bureau of Labor Statistics.
Economists polled by Dow Jones expected a 5.5% increase.
This came after the Wednesday release of the consumer price index, which rose 0.6% for the month and 3.7% annually in September, against estimates of 0.6% and 3.6%, respectively.
I don't believe in saying now what I might do at the meetings that we have in the balance of this year," Warsh said.
Traders are now pricing in a more than 80% chance that the Fed will hold rates, according to the CME FedWatch Tool.
